entities.summary: Nicholas Jacob Tregurtha was a British rugby union player who competed in the 1908 Summer Olympics. He was born in St. Ives, Cornwall, United Kingdom. He died in 1964 in Bodmin, Cornwall. He was a member of the British rugby union team, which won the silver medal.
